records.title: FlashFormer: Whole-Model Kernels for Efficient Low-Batch Inference
records.reason: Full text describes whole-model fusion, pipeline overlap, low-batch experiments, and limitations; it targets latency-sensitive LLM runtime.

records.title: Fine-tuning Quantized Neural Networks with Zeroth-order Optimization
records.reason: The contribution is fine-tuning memory reduction without an inference-time mechanism; training-only efficiency is outside scope.

records.title: Overflow Prevention Enhances Long-Context Recurrent LLMs
records.reason: Inference-time and context relevance are explicit, but the abstract establishes quality improvements rather than reduced runtime, memory, or serving cost.

records.title: Enhancing Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization of Large Language Models Through Saliency-Aware Partial Retraining
records.reason: Direct low-bit LLM compression with accuracy-preservation evidence supports resource-efficient deployment; speedup is not claimed.

records.title: MVDRAM: Enabling GeMV Execution in Unmodified DRAM for Low-Bit LLM Acceleration
records.reason: Full text covers the memory-side GeMV pipeline, overhead removal, implementation, and four-DDR4-module evaluation.

records.title: Token-Driven GammaTune: Adaptive Calibration for Enhanced Speculative Decoding
records.reason: Full text confirms the adaptive speculation-length mechanism and evaluations; this directly optimizes LLM decoding.

records.title: Universality of Layer-Level Entropy-Weighted Quantization Beyond Model Architecture and Size
records.reason: Selective precision has direct LLM deployment-memory effects; FastEWQ also reduces quantization decision overhead.

records.title: Hybrid Offline-online Scheduling Method for Large Language Model Inference Optimization
records.reason: Directly studies inference serving scheduling with utilization and end-to-end time outcomes.

records.title: UniMoD: Efficient Unified Multimodal Transformers with Mixture-of-Depths
records.reason: The abstract reports training savings but does not establish inference-time or serving efficiency.

records.title: Exploiting Sparsity for Long Context Inference: Million Token Contexts on Commodity GPUs
records.reason: Directly addresses inference compute/memory on commodity GPUs and reports long-context performance.

records.title: A Proximal Operator for Inducing 2:4-Sparsity
records.reason: Targets accelerator sparse matrix multiplication and evaluates whole-LLM pruning, giving a concrete hardware/runtime path.

records.title: OASIS: Outlier-Aware KV Cache Clustering for Scaling LLM Inference in CXL Memory Systems
records.reason: IEEE Xplore identified the publisher article/title but returned HTTP 418 “I’m a Teapot”; the DOI URL was also inaccessible. J-GLOBAL exposed only a truncated fragment, not a complete abstract.

records.title: EMS: Adaptive Evict-then-Merge Strategy for Head-wise KV Cache Compression Based on Global-Local Importance
records.reason: Directly targets KV-cache memory overhead during LLM inference and describes a parallel compression method.

records.title: Anchor Attention, Small Cache: Code Generation With Large Language Models
records.reason: Addresses decoding memory overhead while preserving code-generation task performance.

records.title: Taipan: Efficient and Expressive State Space Language Models with Selective Attention
records.reason: Hybrid recurrence and bounded attention directly target long-context language-model compute/memory scaling.

records.title: Multi-Draft Speculative Sampling: Canonical Decomposition and Theoretical Limits
records.reason: Improves a decoding-time inference acceleration technique. Official title uses “Canonical Decomposition and Theoretical Limits,” differing slightly from input.

records.title: Efficiently Deploying LLMs with Controlled Risk
records.reason: Serving-time model selection can avoid expensive calls; the primary abstract explicitly frames deployment efficiency and risk together.

records.title: MINI-SEQUENCE TRANSFORMER: Optimizing Intermediate Memory for Long Sequences Training
records.reason: The abstract describes training memory and sequence-length support only, not inference efficiency.

records.title: A Quantitative Analysis of State Space Model-Based Large Language Model: Study of Hungry Hungry Hippos
records.reason: IEEE DOI publisher route was inaccessible. A university research portal confirmed publication metadata and exposed an abstract, but that is not the primary publisher abstract.

records.title: Compressing Lengthy Context With UltraGist
records.reason: The official arXiv record explicitly marks UltraGist withdrawn and superseded by arXiv:2401.03462v3, whose distinct title is Long Context Compression with Activation Beacon. The successor abstract supports inference efficiency, but the input identity is the withdrawn UltraGist record; retain as borderline pending identity-level confirmation rather than accept the successor as this paper.
